comment: save.c dosave0() writes every other level whose file exists after savegamestate(), and save_dungeon() writes svl.level_info; restore.c dorecover() reads each one back with getlev() and restlevelfile(). The first segment visits Dlvl 3, then level-teleports into the Valley of the Dead and saves there. After the restore, ^V3 returns to the Dlvl 3 that already exists, so goto_level() takes getlev() and u_on_rndspot() rather than mklev(), and ^V40 returns to the Valley through its saved arrival region.
